assertions.name: homology_pairing_matches_zero_mode
assertions.source: Numerical integral of Euler class over Bring fundamental cycle perfectly matches 2/(3π)

description: Numerical integration of the continuous Euler class over the fundamental 2-cycle of the Bring curve (genus 4). The Bring curve is tiled by 240 hyperbolic triangles of angles (π/2, π/4, π/5). The integral yields the Gauss-Bonnet area 12π. The pairing ratio 2g / Area naturally produces the 2/(3π) Bring zero-mode shift, escaping the pointwise Bloch-Wigner transcendence obstruction.
